Hi Alex / Samir,

Thanks again for the time earlier today  good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the load test and performance SLOs.

Recap of targets you called out:
- 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for interactive generation requests (non-streaming)
- Streaming: client needs incremental tokens within ~200-300ms of availability (SSE/HTTP chunking)
- Sustained throughput target: 300 requests/minute during peak windows
- Concurrency target: up to 30 concurrent streams per app instance during peak

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood to provide a test account (API key + scoped environment) and a recommended k6 script.
2) Finwise to allowlist Redwood egress IPs for the test environment.
3) Agree test windows: dry-run Wed Nov 17 16:00-16:30 PST, full run Thu Nov 18 09:00-11:00 PST.
4) Run load test, collect perf logs, and follow up with results + action items.

I've attached the proposed test plan (finwise_k6_test_plan.pdf). Rishi and Aditya are looped on the technical bits.

CC: @Rishi for API/test account details, @Aditya for ramp strategy.

Thanks  talk soon,

Marissa Cole
